titre: Exercices — La voix passive et ses emplois
consigne: Cherche chaque exercice au brouillon avant d'ouvrir le corrigé.

exercices.enonce: Mets au passif : People speak French in Quebec.
corrige: Sujet passif = French.
Présent simple passif = is + participe passé.
exercices.reponse: French is spoken in Quebec.

exercices.enonce: Mets au passif : A famous architect designed this museum. (garde l'agent)
corrige: Objet → sujet : This museum.
Prétérit passif = was + designed + by.
exercices.reponse: This museum was designed by a famous architect.

exercices.enonce: Mets au passif : Someone has broken the window.
corrige: Agent inconnu → on l'omet.
Present perfect passif = has been + participe passé.
exercices.reponse: The window has been broken.

exercices.enonce: Mets au passif : You must finish the report today.
corrige: Modal + be + participe passé.
must be finished.
exercices.reponse: The report must be finished today.

exercices.enonce: Complète avec by ou with : The painting was signed ___ the artist and cleaned ___ a soft brush.
corrige: Auteur de l'action → by.
Instrument → with.
exercices.reponse: signed by the artist and cleaned with a soft brush.

exercices.enonce: Mets la personne en sujet : They sent Tom a parcel.
corrige: Personne (Tom) → sujet.
was sent a parcel.
exercices.reponse: Tom was sent a parcel.

exercices.enonce: Corrige : The accident was happened last night.
corrige: Happen est intransitif : pas de passif.
On garde l'actif : happened.
exercices.reponse: The accident happened last night.

exercices.enonce: Mets au passif : They are building a new stadium.
corrige: Présent continu passif = is/are being + participe passé.
a new stadium → sujet.
exercices.reponse: A new stadium is being built.

exercices.enonce: Transforme : People say that she is a genius. (deux passifs possibles)
corrige: Forme 1 : It is said that she is a genius.
Forme 2 : She is said to be a genius.
exercices.reponse: It is said that she is a genius. / She is said to be a genius.

exercices.enonce: Réécris au passif ce court texte scientifique : « We heated the sample, then we measured its mass. »
corrige: Style scientifique → passif sans agent.
heated → was heated ; measured → was measured.
exercices.reponse: The sample was heated, then its mass was measured.

exercices.enonce: Mets au passif : « They make cars in this factory. »
corrige: Objet actif (cars) → sujet ; agent général (they) omis.
Présent simple passif : are + made.
exercices.reponse: Cars are made in this factory.

exercices.enonce: Mets au passif : « Someone stole my bike yesterday. »
corrige: Agent inconnu (someone) : on l'omet.
Prétérit passif : was + stolen (steal – stole – stolen).
exercices.reponse: My bike was stolen yesterday.

exercices.enonce: Donne le participe passé de : write, build, sell, speak, give.
corrige: Ce sont des verbes irréguliers ; le passif utilise la 3e colonne.
written, built, sold, spoken, given.
exercices.reponse: written, built, sold, spoken, given.

exercices.enonce: Mets au passif : « They will announce the results tomorrow. »
corrige: Futur passif : will be + participe passé.
the results → sujet ; they omis.
exercices.reponse: The results will be announced tomorrow.

exercices.enonce: Mets au passif : « People drink tea all over the world. »
corrige: Agent général (people) : on l'omet.
Présent simple passif : is + drunk (drink – drank – drunk).
exercices.reponse: Tea is drunk all over the world.

exercices.enonce: Mets au passif en gardant l'agent : « The mayor will open the new library. »
corrige: the new library → sujet.
Futur passif : will be opened by the mayor.
exercices.reponse: The new library will be opened by the mayor.

exercices.enonce: Mets au passif en gardant l'agent : « Shakespeare wrote Romeo and Juliet. »
corrige: Romeo and Juliet devient sujet.
Prétérit passif : was written by.
exercices.reponse: Romeo and Juliet was written by Shakespeare.

exercices.enonce: Mets au passif : « The storm destroyed many houses. » (garde l'agent)
corrige: many houses (pluriel) → sujet : were.
were destroyed by the storm.
exercices.reponse: Many houses were destroyed by the storm.

exercices.enonce: Mets au passif : « They have cancelled the concert. »
corrige: Present perfect passif : has been + participe passé.
the concert (singulier) → has been cancelled.
exercices.reponse: The concert has been cancelled. (canceled en américain)

exercices.enonce: Mets au passif : « You can recycle this bottle. »
corrige: Modal + be + participe passé.
can be recycled.
exercices.reponse: This bottle can be recycled.

exercices.enonce: Mets au passif : « You should wash these vegetables before cooking. »
corrige: should + be + participe passé ; these vegetables (pluriel) devient sujet.
should be washed.
exercices.reponse: These vegetables should be washed before cooking.

exercices.enonce: Mets au passif : « They are repairing the road. »
corrige: Présent continu passif : is being + participe passé.
The road is being repaired.
exercices.reponse: The road is being repaired.

exercices.enonce: Complète avec by ou with : « The window was broken ___ a stone ___ two boys. »
corrige: Instrument (a stone) → with.
Auteurs de l'action (two boys) → by.
exercices.reponse: with ; by.

exercices.enonce: Complète avec by ou with : « The door was opened ___ a key. » / « The door was opened ___ the caretaker. »
corrige: Une clé est un instrument → with.
Le gardien est l'auteur de l'action → by.
exercices.reponse: with ; by.

exercices.enonce: Mets la personne en sujet : « They offered Lucy a job. »
corrige: Avec un verbe à deux objets, la personne devient sujet (forme préférée).
Lucy was offered a job.
exercices.reponse: Lucy was offered a job.

exercices.enonce: Donne les deux passifs possibles de : « They showed the visitors the castle. »
corrige: Personne sujet (préféré) : The visitors were shown the castle.
Chose sujet : The castle was shown to the visitors.
exercices.reponse: The visitors were shown the castle. / The castle was shown to the visitors.

exercices.enonce: Mets au passif avec la personne en sujet : « The teacher told us the truth. » (garde l'agent)
corrige: us → sujet : we.
were told the truth by the teacher.
exercices.reponse: We were told the truth by the teacher.

exercices.enonce: Corrige : « My grandfather was died in 2010. »
corrige: die est intransitif : il n'a pas de passif.
On écrit died (actif).
exercices.reponse: My grandfather died in 2010.

exercices.enonce: Parmi ces verbes, lesquels ne peuvent pas être mis au passif : build, arrive, sell, come, write ?
corrige: Les verbes intransitifs n'ont pas de passif.
arrive et come sont intransitifs.
exercices.reponse: arrive et come.

exercices.enonce: Corrige : « This song sung by a famous singer. »
corrige: Il manque l'auxiliaire be.
This song is (ou was) sung…
exercices.reponse: This song is sung by a famous singer. (was sung, au passé)

exercices.enonce: Corrige : « The letter was writed yesterday. »
corrige: write est irrégulier : write – wrote – written.
was written.
exercices.reponse: The letter was written yesterday.

exercices.enonce: Corrige : « The books was sold in one day. »
corrige: be s'accorde avec le sujet pluriel the books.
were sold.
exercices.reponse: The books were sold in one day.

exercices.enonce: Mets au passif : « Someone was following me. »
corrige: Prétérit continu passif : was / were being + participe passé.
I was being followed (agent inconnu omis).
exercices.reponse: I was being followed.

exercices.enonce: Mets la phrase passive à l'actif : « The match was won by our team. »
corrige: L'agent (our team) redevient sujet.
Prétérit actif : won.
exercices.reponse: Our team won the match.

exercices.enonce: Mets à l'actif : « The cake has been eaten by the children. »
corrige: L'agent (the children) devient sujet.
Present perfect actif : have eaten (sujet pluriel).
exercices.reponse: The children have eaten the cake.

exercices.enonce: Dans « My wallet was stolen on the bus », pourquoi l'agent n'est-il pas exprimé ?
corrige: On ne sait pas qui a volé le portefeuille.
Quand l'auteur est inconnu, on emploie le passif sans agent.
exercices.reponse: Parce que l'auteur du vol est inconnu.

exercices.enonce: Pourquoi dit-on « English is spoken here » plutôt que « English is spoken here by people » ?
corrige: L'agent (les gens) est évident et général.
On omet un agent évident ou sans intérêt.
exercices.reponse: Parce que l'agent (les gens) est évident : on l'omet.

exercices.enonce: Dans « This tower was designed by Gustave Eiffel », pourquoi garde-t-on l'agent ?
corrige: L'agent est ici une information nouvelle et importante.
Le passif permet de la placer en fin de phrase, là où elle est mise en valeur.
exercices.reponse: Parce que l'agent est l'information nouvelle et importante, placée en fin de phrase.

exercices.enonce: Transforme de deux façons : « People believe that the house is haunted. »
corrige: It is believed that + proposition.
The house is believed to be haunted.
exercices.reponse: It is believed that the house is haunted. / The house is believed to be haunted.

exercices.enonce: Transforme : « People know that this region is dangerous. » (forme It is…)
corrige: It is known that + proposition.
It is known that this region is dangerous.
exercices.reponse: It is known that this region is dangerous.

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « On a construit ce pont en 1990. »
corrige: « On » + agent inconnu : passif sans agent.
Prétérit passif : was built.
exercices.reponse: This bridge was built in 1990.

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « On m'a donné un cadeau pour mon anniversaire. »
corrige: Verbe à deux objets : la personne devient sujet.
I was given a present.
exercices.reponse: I was given a present for my birthday.

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « On dit qu'il est très riche. » (deux traductions)
corrige: Structure impersonnelle : It is said that…
Ou bien : He is said to be…
exercices.reponse: It is said that he is very rich. / He is said to be very rich.

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Le nouveau musée sera inauguré l'année prochaine. »
corrige: Futur passif : will be + participe passé.
inaugurer = to open (ou to inaugurate).
exercices.reponse: The new museum will be opened (inaugurated) next year.

exercices.enonce: Réécris ce compte rendu d'expérience au passif (style scientifique, sans agent) : « We filled a glass with water. Then we added some salt. »
corrige: Style scientifique : passif sans agent.
filled → was filled ; added → was added.
exercices.reponse: A glass was filled with water. Then some salt was added.

exercices.enonce: Réécris cette brève de journal au passif, sans agent : « Someone has robbed a bank in the town centre. Police have arrested two men. »
corrige: Agent inconnu : A bank has been robbed.
Agent évident (la police) : Two men have been arrested.
exercices.reponse: A bank has been robbed in the town centre. Two men have been arrested.

exercices.enonce: Corrige les erreurs : « The house was build in 1900 and was sell by its owner in 2015. »
corrige: build est irrégulier : build – built – built → was built.
sell est irrégulier : sell – sold – sold → was sold.
exercices.reponse: The house was built in 1900 and was sold by its owner in 2015.

exercices.enonce: Lis cette phrase : « The parcel was delivered with a drone by a local company. » Identifie l'agent et l'instrument, puis réécris-la à l'actif.
corrige: Agent (by) : a local company ; instrument (with) : a drone.
À l'actif : l'agent devient sujet.
exercices.reponse: Agent : a local company ; instrument : a drone. → A local company delivered the parcel with a drone.

exercices.enonce: Rédige en anglais deux phrases au passif pour présenter ton lycée (date de construction, nombre d'élèves accueillis).
corrige: Utilise was built et is attended (ou are taught).
Exemple de réponse : « My school was built in 1970. About 1,000 students are taught there every year. »
exercices.reponse: Exemple : My school was built in 1970. About 1,000 students are taught there every year.

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Les résultats ont été publiés hier, et les meilleurs élèves seront récompensés. »
corrige: Avec « hier » (moment passé précis), on emploie le prétérit passif : were published.
Futur passif : will be rewarded.
exercices.reponse: The results were published yesterday, and the best students will be rewarded.
